en.headline: International landscape architects congress opens in Hong Kong for the first time
en.dek: More than 1,000 participants from over 80 countries and regions are attending the three-day event at Kerry Hotel in Hung Hom under the theme of shifting watersheds and coastlines.
body: The International Federation of Landscape Architects World and Asia-Pacific Regional Congress is being held in Hong Kong for the first time, running from 28 to 30 October at Kerry Hotel in Hung Hom.

The organisers said the three-day event, themed “Liminal Landscapes: Shifting Boundaries of Watersheds and Coastlines,” has drawn more than 1,000 participants from over 80 countries and regions. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn addressed the opening ceremony, highlighting Hong Kong’s waterfront improvements.

Linn said the total length of the Victoria Harbour waterfront promenade has increased from 23 km in 2020 to about 33 km. With the full opening of the East Coast Boardwalk last year, the 13-km-long waterfront on the northern shore of Hong Kong Island is now fully connected.

She also cited the Tsui Ping River revitalisation in East Kowloon, the Tung Chung eco-shoreline project and Tseung Kwan O South Park as examples of how the city is integrating sustainable design into its landscapes and drainage systems.

zh.headline: 國際園境師聯盟世界大會首度在港舉行
zh.dek: 超過1,000名來自80多個國家及地區的參與者出席在紅磚嘉里酒店舉行的三日活動，主題為變遷中的流域與海岸線。
body: 國際園境師聯盟世界暨亞太區大會首度在香港舉行，由10月28日至30日於紅磚嘉里酒店進行。
主辦方表示，這場以「邊際景觀：變遷中的流域與海岸線」為主題的三日活動，匯聚超過1,000名來自80多個國家及地區的參與者。發展局局長甫漢豪在開幕典禮致辭，分享香港優化海濱的例子。
甫漢豪說，維港兩岸海濱長廊總長度已由2020年的23公里增至約33公里。隨著東岸板道去年全面開放，全長約13公里的港島北海濱亦已正式打通。
她亦提到東九龍翠屏河活化項目、東涌生態海岸線項目及將軍澳南公園，展示香港如何將可持續設計融入景觀及排水系統。
